name: Travel MCP Server
description: Combined MCP server: reward flights, Google Flights, and Google Maps on a single dyno

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: Transport mode: stdio, sse, or streamable-http

FLIGHTS_RATE_LIMIT.description: Max requests/sec for Google Flights scraping (default: 0.5)

MAPS_RATE_LIMIT.description: Max requests/sec to Google Maps API (default: 10.0)

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR (default: INFO)
